mod.description: Saves your Spore game automatically at meaningful moments instead of on a timer: when you enter or leave a creation editor at any stage, when your creature ranks up, when you ally with or defeat a tribe, when you take a new city, and when you enter or leave an adventure. Saving no longer stops the game with a 'your game has been saved' box - a save icon and a short line fade in at the top right instead, on a soft-edged plate that blends into the picture.
